rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Azure FHIR MCP Server provides a bridge between AI assistants and Azure Health Data Services FHIR servers, enabling secure access to healthcare data through the Model Context Protocol. Developed by Erik Howard, it implements OAuth2 authentication with Azure Active Directory and offers comprehensive tools for searching and retrieving FHIR resources across 70+ resource types. The server dynamically generates resource functions for all FHIR resources, handles error reporting through the MCP context system, and maintains detailed logging—making it particularly valuable for healthcare applications requiring secure, standards-compliant access to patient records, clinical observations, and medical documentation.
